Reference evapotranspiration (grass ETo, alfalfa ETr)

Source: R/reference-et.R
ef_ref_et.Rd

Computes the reference evapotranspiration with the combination (Penman-Monteith) equation of a hypothetical reference surface, for the grass reference of FAO-56 (ETo) or the tall alfalfa reference of the ASCE-EWRI standardized equation (ETr, the reference used by METRIC), with a daily or an hourly time step. All choices are explicit arguments without defaults. The inputs are the reference-surface quantities already computed (net radiation, soil heat flux, slope of the saturation curve, psychrometric constant, vapour pressure deficit, wind at 2 m).

Usage

ef_ref_et(
  net_radiation,
  soil_heat_flux,
  air_temperature,
  wind_speed_2m,
  vapour_pressure_deficit,
  slope,
  psychrometric,
  reference,
  timestep,
  standard,
  daytime = NULL
)

Arguments

net_radiation

Numeric. Net radiation of the reference surface \(R_n\) [MJ m-2 d-1 or MJ m-2 h-1], from ef_ref_net_radiation(). Any finite value.

soil_heat_flux

Numeric. Soil heat flux of the reference surface \(G\) in the same unit, from ef_ref_soil_heat_flux() (0 for daily steps). Any finite value.

air_temperature

Numeric. Air temperature [degrees Celsius]: the daily mean \((T_{max} + T_{min})/2\) for daily steps, the hourly mean for hourly steps. Finite and > -273.

wind_speed_2m

Numeric. Wind speed at 2 m \(u_2\) [m s-1], from ef_wind_2m(). Finite and >= 0.

vapour_pressure_deficit

Numeric. Vapour pressure deficit \(e_s - e_a\) [kPa] (ef_es() and the ef_ea functions). Any finite value: a negative deficit (actual above saturation vapour pressure) is kept.

slope

Numeric. Slope of the saturation vapour pressure curve \(\Delta\) [kPa degC-1], from ef_es_slope(). Finite and > 0.

psychrometric

Numeric. Psychrometric constant \(\gamma\) [kPa degC-1], from ef_psychrometric(). Finite and > 0.

reference

Character, no default. "grass" (ETo, short reference, 0.12 m) or "alfalfa" (ETr, tall reference, about 0.5 m). It is kept in the result, because a crop coefficient on a grass basis and a METRIC reference fraction on an alfalfa basis are not interchangeable.

timestep

Character, no default. "daily" or "hourly".

standard

Character, no default. "fao56" (FAO-56 Eqs. 6 and 53; grass only, VERIFICADA) or "asce" (ASCE-EWRI 2005 standardized constants, CANDIDATA).

daytime

Logical or NULL. Required for timestep = "hourly" with standard = "asce", where \(C_d\) differs by day and night: TRUE for daytime periods (NA gives NA); the day/night criterion is the caller's choice (decision WF-15). Not used with standard = "fao56" (\(C_d\) = 0.34 day and night); must be NULL for daily steps.

Value

An object of class earthflux_reference_et: a list with

  • et_ref: reference evapotranspiration [mm d-1 for daily steps, mm h-1 for hourly steps], numeric with the common length (and dim) of the inputs; negative values are kept;

  • reference, timestep, standard: the choices made;

  • flags: list of earthflux_flag records (record scope) for the codes that hold somewhere: EF_INPUT_NA and EF_WS_ETR_NEGATIVE (negative reference ET, kept; the code covers ETo and ETr);

  • provenance: the rows of the constants table used (constants, with source and status of each), the verification status ("VERIFICADA" for FAO-56 grass, "CANDIDATA" otherwise), references, flags_evaluated and package version.

Details

$$ET_{ref} = \frac{0.408\,\Delta (R_n - G) + \gamma \frac{C_n}{T + 273} u_2 (e_s - e_a)}{\Delta + \gamma (1 + C_d u_2)}$$ With \(C_n\) = 900 and \(C_d\) = 0.34 it is FAO-56 Eq. 6 (daily ETo, mm d-1); with \(C_n\) = 37 and \(C_d\) = 0.34, FAO-56 Eq. 53 (hourly ETo, mm h-1). The constants come from one internal table with the source and status of each row (dev/specs/weather-forcing.md 5.3):

Reference, standard, step\(C_n\)\(C_d\)Status
grass, "fao56", daily9000.34VERIFICADA
grass, "fao56", hourly370.34VERIFICADA
grass, "asce", daily9000.34CANDIDATA
alfalfa, "asce", daily16000.38CANDIDATA
grass, "asce", hourly370.24 day / 0.96 nightCANDIDATA
alfalfa, "asce", hourly660.25 day / 1.7 nightCANDIDATA

FAO-56 reference surface: hypothetical grass 0.12 m high, fixed surface resistance 70 s m-1 and albedo 0.23, with measurements at 2 m (FAO-56, chapter 2). The factor 0.408 (1 / 2.45 MJ kg-1) and 273 in the aerodynamic term are the literals of the standard (decision WF-14). FAO-56 (chapter 4) warns that the fixed surface resistance may underestimate hourly ETo in daytime and overestimate it in the evening, and that hourly values summed over 24 hours generally match the daily computation.

standard matters for the grass reference. For hourly grass, FAO-56 uses \(C_d\) = 0.34 day and night, while the ASCE-EWRI candidate constants use 0.24 / 0.96: with the inputs of FAO-56 example 19 (14:00-15:00) they give 0.627 and 0.656 mm h-1.

standard = "fao56" with reference = "alfalfa" raises earthflux_undefined_reference (also earthflux_input_error): FAO-56 does not define the tall reference. The constants of the alfalfa reference verify only the arithmetic here: a verification case for ETr requires the examples of ASCE-EWRI (2005), not yet read.

The instantaneous reference ET at the satellite overpass (spec 5.5) and the daily ETr from hourly values (spec 5.6) belong to the station orchestration, not to this function.

Missing values propagate (and are flagged EF_INPUT_NA). Negative results (for example at night, when \(R_n - G < 0\) with a small deficit) are kept and flagged EF_WS_ETR_NEGATIVE (principle 6), never truncated. Missing or unknown choices raise earthflux_missing_input or earthflux_unknown_method; values outside the domains above raise earthflux_domain_error.

Verification status

standard = "fao56", reference = "grass": VERIFICADA (FAO-56, chapter 4, Eqs. 6 and 53; examples 18 and 19, cases V14-V16 of dev/specs/weather-forcing.md 8.1). standard = "asce" (short and tall reference, daily and hourly, day and night \(C_d\)): CANDIDATA (ASCE-EWRI, 2005, was not accessible; constants from secondary implementations; implemented as CANDIDATA by direction of the author to advance milestone M3; dev/specs/weather-forcing.md 13).

References

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., & Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements (FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56). FAO, Rome. ISBN 92-5-104219-5.

ASCE-EWRI (2005). The ASCE Standardized Reference Evapotranspiration Equation. American Society of Civil Engineers. doi:10.1061/9780784408056

See also

Other reference evapotranspiration functions: ef_ref_net_radiation(), ef_ref_soil_heat_flux()

Examples

# FAO-56 example 18 (Uccle, 6 July, 100 m): daily grass ETo
tmean <- (21.5 + 12.3) / 2
ea <- ef_ea_daily(tmin = 12.3, tmax = 21.5, rh_max = 84, rh_min = 63,
                  method = "rhmax_rhmin")
es <- mean(ef_es(c(21.5, 12.3)))
rn <- ef_ref_net_radiation(solar_radiation = 22.07,
                           clear_sky_radiation = 30.90,
                           vapour_pressure = ea, tmax = 21.5, tmin = 12.3,
                           timestep = "daily")$rn
eto <- ef_ref_et(
  net_radiation = rn, soil_heat_flux = 0, air_temperature = tmean,
  wind_speed_2m = ef_wind_2m(10 / 3.6, 10),
  vapour_pressure_deficit = es - ea, slope = ef_es_slope(tmean),
  psychrometric = ef_psychrometric(ef_air_pressure(100)),
  reference = "grass", timestep = "daily", standard = "fao56"
)
eto$et_ref
#> [1] 3.880101

# Same inputs, tall reference with the ASCE-EWRI candidate constants
ef_ref_et(
  net_radiation = rn, soil_heat_flux = 0, air_temperature = tmean,
  wind_speed_2m = ef_wind_2m(10 / 3.6, 10),
  vapour_pressure_deficit = es - ea, slope = ef_es_slope(tmean),
  psychrometric = ef_psychrometric(ef_air_pressure(100)),
  reference = "alfalfa", timestep = "daily", standard = "asce"
)$et_ref
#> [1] 4.606384
